sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:109

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:109:1
items.html: Then these Mochin, called the Neshama of ZA, were in the discernment of MAN to Bina, and AVI coupled and corrected the Malchut not by means of ZA: This has already been explained above in several places: that the matter of the Durmita [deep slumber] and the withdrawal of the Mochin of Hochma and Hassadim of ZA for the sake of the sawing, its meaning is the rising of MAN to AVI — for even the Gadlut of vessels she cannot receive from ZA, except through the rising of MAN to AVI, since she needs the coupling of AB SAG to bring down the bottom Hey from her Einayim, and to raise up the vessels of her AHP and join them to her degree, in order to complete her in ten Sefirot.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:109:2
items.html: At the Nesirah, the two of them join together into one Partzuf: For in Katnut, when the Nukva had only the GE of vessels, and lacked the AHP of vessels and the GAR of Lights, her stature was from the Chazeh of ZA downward. But now that she has attained her AHP, she has acquired ten vessels just like ZA himself, and therefore she joined with Leah into one Partzuf, since she now clothes the whole stature of ZA, for on the side of the vessels their statures are equal. However, on the side of the Lights she is still lacking, until the second coupling, as above, and therefore she clothes him from his posteriors, and not from the side of the anterior, until she attains the Lights as well, like ZA; and then she returns with him in an equal stature, from the discernment of the anterior of ZA.
